messages.message:
NVDA ($160) - GETTING INTERESTING NOW
By some margin the most topical subject and luckily one that I know a little bit about, having been following it for about 20 years, during most of which I had the illustrious Campo either next to me or opposite me. Here's the thing. There will be millions of column inches written about the "G" in ESG. Millions. Lots of people including the idiotic Dan Ives will be wheeled out for their learned views, many people will dump the stock and many of the sweetheart deals and investments will come under scrutiny and we can safely assume the 15% of Sales to "Singapore", that we highlighted as long ago as 2023 when we were at Chameleon and sales to "Singapore" suddenly went from 2% of Sales to 15% (!!!!) will likely diminish towards nothing.

BUT here is some back of the fag packet analysis. Assume a chop of 25% to Jan 2028 (i.e. 2027) EPS. Put the stock on 15x P/E. Whilst bearing in mind top line and EPS are growing at 50%+ ostensibly despite everything. You get $179. Last pr…
